fullPassage: Chaske, a Cherokee boy, was sitting on a tree stump. As a rite of passage for youths in his tribe, Chaske had to survive one night in the forest wearing a blindfold, not knowing he was observed by his father. After the sunset, Chaske could hear all kinds of noises. The wind blew the grass and shook his stump. A sense of dread swept through his body. What if wild beasts are looking at me? I can't stand this! Just as he was about to take off the blindfold to run away, a voice came in from somewhere. "I'm here around you. Don't give up, and complete your mission." It was his father's voice. He has been watching me from nearby! With just the presence of his father, the boy regained stability. What panicked him awfully a moment ago vanished into thin air.

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하여 (영어로) 쓰시오. (4단어)

"그 소년은 안정을 되찾았다."

[조건] (1) boy, regained, stability, the를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 4단어로 쓸 것

boy / regained / stability / the

det.korean: The boy regained stability.
det.analysis: 정답: the boy regained stability — 주어(the boy) + 동사(regained) + 목적어(stability)
